title: callista lawsonia
intro: Callista lawsonia, commonly known as the Indian snail tree or nictandra, is a plant species native to India and Southeast Asia. The Indian snail tree has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its potential to reduce inflammation and kill bacteria. The therapeutic actions of Callista lawsonia include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
